title: Magus Cadence
summary: Magus Cadence is an Arcane Enhancement for the Operator that increases Sprint Speed for 12 seconds after a Void Sling.
extract:
Magus Cadence is an Arcane Enhancement for the Operator that increases Sprint Speed for 12 seconds after a Void Sling.

Effect

Acquisition
Can be bought from The Quills for  10,000 each.

Notes
Sprint Speed only affects the Operator and not the Warframe.
